description: This file defines the GrainVersioningOptions class, which contains configuration options related to grain versioning strategies in Orleans. It includes properties for default compatibility strategy and version selector strategy.

classes.name: GrainVersioningOptions
classes.description: Contains options for configuring grain versioning behavior, including strategies for compatibility and version selection.

methods.name: DefaultCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Gets or sets the name of the strategy used to determine grain compatibility in deployments.

methods.name: DefaultVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Gets or sets the name of the strategy used for selecting grain versions in deployments.
